steps.text: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth, sugar and salt, and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the cream and basil.
Taste, adjust the salt, and serve hot.
